expand_more
Gazetteer of OS-00 and Connected Domains
1. System Core & Transit Hubs
VERGE Control L44²: The central control node and routing nexus of the system
1
2
. It features an argon-gas sealed chamber, a black-light rainbow switchboard, a four-way viewport quad mapping routes across the network, and the Discontrol Systemworx console
1
more_horiz
. Here, the console HUD monitors the oscillating Lissajous waveform, displaying the core operational law: OPERATOR = INSTRUMENT
1
more_horiz
.
OS-01 Midway & Backlot: A clinical-institutional carnival midway operating under dimmed lighting and black-light rainbow illumination
6
more_horiz
. Key landmarks include an iodine-glass ticket window, argon-fog turnstiles, a LOST-GUARDIANS kiosk issuing fluorescing claim tags, and a monorail platform servicing multi-world transit
6
more_horiz
.
Mare Frigoris Loop & Quarry (1936): An airless lunar and Martian quarry set styled after early 20th-century speculative space exploration
2
more_horiz
. It houses a half-buried monorail loop and an iodine-glass ticket kiosk that accepts non-standard tender, such as doctor's notes written in microcrystal adderall-ink, converting them into black-light rainbow credits
2
more_horiz
.
Operator Stair L44²: A multi-level transit stairwell constructed with heavy iron treads descending through argon haze
14
15
. Its walls are decorated with glowing murals depicting the Piedmont pipes, Reactor Hall schematics, and the OS-01 loop
14
15
. Access to the VERGE control room landing requires slotting a cadmium C-cell token into the door
14
15
.
2. Industrial & Power Infrastructure
Reactor Hall A / OS-01 Reactor Mezzanine: An expansive industrial power complex marked by safety rails, hazard chevrons, overhead crane cams (C02), and Cherenkov radiation cooling pools
10
more_horiz
. In system operations, this facility forms the high-tech ELSEWHERE half of the superposed HOME // ELSEWHERE reality frame
16
more_horiz
.
Subsurface Foundries & Titan Outposts: Deep subsurface industrial sites located on Titan and Mars
20
more_horiz
. These sectors combine heavy manufacturing foundries with roadside commercial pods, including cryogenic bignet bagel saloons, adobe drive-thru yurts, and macro-panoramic infrared observation stations
20
21
.
Old Zapatista Nuclear Engineering Lab: A clandestine, rural research facility blending revolutionary folk aesthetics with high-grade particle physics and nuclear engineering apparatuses
23
.
3. Hydro-Ritualistic & Botanical Sanctuaries
Piedmontese Baths & Waterworks: A secluded glade located in the forests of Northern Italy
24
25
. It features an elaborate, brutalist industrial network of lead Rube Goldberg pipe-tunnels and sousaphone-shaped water conduits emptying into jade-green springwater pools
24
more_horiz
. The site is maintained by middle-aged matrons of a hydro-ritualist fertility cult clad in sheer linen gowns and traditional Piedmontese headdresses
24
more_horiz
.
The Piedmont Midnight Kitchen (HOME): A domestic interior modeled after a warm 1936 Piedmont home
16
19
. It features varnished pine counters, enameled kettles, lace curtains, and fresh pies on cooling racks
16
19
. It serves as the grounding HOME counterpart when reality is bifurcated across the system
16
18
.
Underwater Martian Library-Forest: A terraformed red-planet botanical habitat combining algae-tinted stacks, pressurized reading pods, and coral bookshelves submerged beneath liquid canopy
30
31
. Deep within rests a high-pressure bathysphere chamber constructed from Victorian woodwork, Balinese filigree, and crustpunk welding
32
33
.
4. Commercial & Urban Sectors
Socotra Bodega & Games Row GR07: A commercial gaming and trade pit featuring craps felt illuminated under UV light
10
34
. It houses the LOCATION TABLE d6, where dice rolls determine destination coordinates across six primary sectors: Diner, Reactor Hall A, OS-01 Midway, Mare Frigoris 1936, Piedmontese Baths, and Socotra Bodega
10
more_horiz
.
Route 66 Martian Taco Stand: An open-air roadside taco vendor positioned directly on the unpressurized red dust of Mars, recorded in the deadpan documentary style of a wide-angle NASA rover image
36
more_horiz
.
Anarcho-Communist Harlem Pancake House: An open-air, ecoutopian civic eatery in Harlem, captured via lo-fi 1264k security camera footage
39
40
.
Capitol of the Universe: A cosmic urban center captured during the blue hour at 4:47 AM
41
more_horiz
. It is defined by quiet streetlamp haloes, damp asphalt reflecting alien constellations, and closed diplomatic embassies
41
more_horiz
.
5. High-Dimensional & Anomalous Zones
Sublunar Honey-Liquid Nitrogen Necropolis: A moon-adjacent grave-city built from viscous 10mm honey, hypercold liquid nitrogen, ferrofluid, and escherian mochi-gelatine labyrinths
46
more_horiz
.
The 4D Torus / Edge Transit Superposition: A non-Euclidean spatial anomaly created when HUD parameters are set to θ=44.44
∘
 radians
49
more_horiz
. When a cadmium-denim flip token lands on its rim, the system triggers an EDGE-RULE, locking HOME and ELSEWHERE into a single, superposed space bound by a lacquered, tufted spider-lattice filigree
16
more_horiz
.
